productionChange: Reuses existing result renderer inside existing scroll container; no new request, persistence or authorization path.
resultOwnership: Only this dialog runs.responses; no shared providerProbeResponse injected; hook invalidates response on scope change and unmount.
rendering: Existing React text rendering, exact account and plan filtering; no HTML injection.
fixtureBoundary: New absolute fixture root; loopback listener; task-local synthetic upstream; production login and secret grant preserved.
cleanup: Browser and proxy close before finish/abort. Host closes management TCP, local runtime and peer before acceptance assertions. 30-minute test timeout is process bound.
transport: Static root is explicit; loopback-only API target; streams upload/request and response; 190-second request timeout; client-close propagates to upstream.
data: Synthetic credentials and prompts only. No real user profile, live database or online instance.
limitations: Source snapshot was taken during compilation, not a complete pre-build freeze.
New browser harness is opt-in and requires installed Edge or Chrome.
